title: Mathematics: Textbook for Class XII, Part I (Chapters 1-6) and Part II (Chapters 7-13) — Grade 12 Mathematics (CBSE / NCERT)

source.title: Mathematics: Textbook for Class XII, Part I (Chapters 1-6) and Part II (Chapters 7-13)
source.edition: Part I first edition November 2006 (ISBN 81-7450-629-2); rationalised content in force since 2022-23 and continued unchanged in 2026-27; the exact 2026-27 reprint line of Part I and Part II could not be read (ncert.nic.in PDFs blocked to my fetcher)
source.licence: Chapter and section titles as printed (facts); outcomes written by OpenPath in its own words; no textbook text is reproduced.

review.by: OpenPath curriculum inventory (research from official and secondary sources; not an educator review)
review.note: Built from content/learning/syllabus/cbse-g12.json. 3 of 13 chapter titles could not be checked against an official source (marked sourceVerified: false). Each outcome was mapped to competencies by the inventory; outcomes were placed in sections by shared title words. Sources: https://cbseacademic.nic.in/web_material/CurriculumMain27/SecPart2/Maths_SecP2_2026-27.pdf https://cbseacademic.nic.in/curriculum_2027.html https://www.cbseacademic.nic.in/web_material/CurriculumMain26/SrSec/Maths_SrSec_2025-26.pdf https://ncert.nic.in/textbook/pdf/lemh1ps.pdf. Notes: Textbook: no new NCERT Class XII Mathematics book exists for 2026-27; CBSE 2026-27 prescribes 'Mathematics Part I' and 'Part II' (NCERT) plus Exemplar and Lab Manual, editions unstated. I could not read the current Part I/Part II prelims (ncert.nic.in/textbook/pdf is blocked by robots for my fetcher; an older 2019-20 Part I prelims was returned from cache), so the reprint year is not verified. Section lists were DERIVED, not read from the current print: the pre-rationalisation contents (official, 2019-20) minus the sections NCERT's 2022 rationalisation list removes, cross-checked against the SATHEE reproduction. Section numbering in the current book may differ; titles only are recorded. Conflicts between sources: SATHEE still shows '5.8 Mean Value Theorem' (Ch 5), a 'Properties of Determinants' heading (Ch 4), '8.2.1 area bounded by a curve and a line' (Ch 8), and the whole Plane material 11.6-11.10 (Ch 11), all of which the NCERT rationalisation list removes and none of which is in the CBSE 2026-27 topic list. I followed the rationalisation list and the CBSE curriculum and left them out.
